collection.title: Piaggio Porter Tipper 2001 to 2017 Windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: All of the following wiper blades will fit a Piaggio Porter 2001 - 2017 model which requires a 16" wiper blade on the drivers side and a 16" for the passengers side. This model uses the Standard Hook arm attachment to fix the blade to the wiper arm.
